name: Kirisato
source:
One of the most well-known courtesans in the red-light district. There are many people who are captivated by her sensual alto tones. She is a good confidant for the protagonist, as she is both kind and wise. Yet she seems to be hiding a very big secret.

[Edited from [url=https://www.cyikemen.com/DestinedToLove/pc/index.html]official website[/url]]
